name: Core elements
description: Every element kind, for any game system: scenes, read-aloud texts, Information, people, creatures, countdowns, dice, checks, handouts, boxes, quotes, pacing notes, codex cards and references, maps, the relationship chart and the layout markers; the built-in codex types Person, Place and Clue; and the six handwriting hands, so every theme offers them (F8). A game system turns on the elements it needs (9.3).
